items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: Yeah. I played dance. You take Jack Paeda, Son, and Thomas. Yeah. Kid Thomas.

ctx.x: Yeah. I played dance. You take Jack Paeda, Son, and Thomas. Yeah. Kid Thomas.
Kid Thomas. Kid Thomas. Yeah. He played them dance. That's getting down to my time now.

But they had another band after it. Before that, before we played that, Edmund Payton. And uh... Payton you say that? Edmund Payton. Edmund Payton. And uh... Boo Boo. Left hand... Bass player? Left hand violin player. Boo Boo, yeah. Yeah, Boo Boo. You know his real name, anybody? I don't know Boo Boo. And uh, who was playing uh... Uh... Some of them, I don't know who was playing uh... Playing bass with him. I don't know, but they had four.
